name: io.leadsail.api/store-audit
title: LeadSail — Software Growth Engine
description: Find buyers at the moment they complain about a competitor. Verified contacts with evidence links.

tools.name: audit_store
tools.description: Run a free readiness audit of a software product page: fetch the page and check the signals that decide whether visitors become buyers (lead capture, CTA, contact info, trust signals, chat, social, mobile, SEO basics, HTTPS). Returns a readiness score and top issues with evidence.

url.description: The software product page URL to audit, e.g. https://example.com/product

tools.name: about_leadsail
tools.description: What LeadSail does, pricing model, and where to sign up.

tools.name: radar_scan
tools.description: Turn Product Hunt product slugs into reachable contacts: finds the maker, their website and public email, checks MX and the outbound gateway's cleaning verdict, and returns evidence links. Requires an X-Api-Key header from a LeadSail account (same key and quota as the REST API).
